14	TEST_DIR_NAMES = {"test", "tests", "__tests__", "spec"}
15	
16	DOC_EXTENSIONS = {".md", ".rst", ".txt", ".adoc"}
17	DOC_NAMES = {"readme", "changelog", "license", "contributing", "authors", "notice"}
18	DOC_DIR_NAMES = {"docs", "doc"}
19	
20	CONFIG_EXTENSIONS = {".toml", ".yaml", ".yml", ".json", ".ini", ".cfg", ".env"}
21	CONFIG_NAMES = {
22	    "dockerfile", "makefile", ".gitignore", ".dockerignore", ".editorconfig",
23	    "pyproject.toml", "package.json", "package-lock.json", "poetry.lock",
24	    "requirements.txt", "setup.py", "setup.cfg", "uv.lock",
25	}
26	
27	SOURCE_EXTENSIONS = {
28	    ".py", ".js", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx", ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".c", ".h",
29	    ".cpp", ".hpp", ".rb", ".php", ".cs", ".swift", ".kt", ".scala", ".sh",
30	}
31	
32	
33	@dataclass
34	class ScannedFile:
35	    path: str  # posix-style, relative to repo root
36	    kind: str  # source | test | doc | config | other
37	    content_hash: str
38	
39	
40	def _load_gitignore_spec(repo_root: Path) -> pathspec.PathSpec:
41	    gitignore = repo_root / ".gitignore"
42	    lines: list[str] = []
43	    if gitignore.exists():
44	        lines = gitignore.read_text(errors="ignore").splitlines()
45	    return pathspec.PathSpec.from_lines("gitignore", lines)
46	
47	
48	def classify_file(rel_path: str) -> str:
49	    p = Path(rel_path)
50	    name_lower = p.name.lower()
51	    ext = p.suffix.lower()
52	    parts_lower = {part.lower() for part in p.parts[:-1]}
53	
54	    if parts_lower & TEST_DIR_NAMES or any(pat in name_lower for pat in TEST_NAME_PATTERNS):
55	        return "test"
56	    if ext in CONFIG_EXTENSIONS or name_lower in CONFIG_NAMES:
57	        return "config"
58	    if ext in DOC_EXTENSIONS or name_lower.split(".")[0] in DOC_NAMES or parts_lower & DOC_DIR_NAMES:
59	        return "doc"
60	    if ext in SOURCE_EXTENSIONS:
61	        return "source"
62	    return "other"
63	
64	
65	def hash_file(path: Path) -> str:
66	    hasher = xxhash.xxh3_64()
67	    hasher.update(path.read_bytes())
68	    return hasher.hexdigest()
69	
70	
71	def scan_files(repo_root: Path) -> list[ScannedFile]:
72	    """Walk repo_root respecting .gitignore + ALWAYS_IGNORE, return classified+hashed files."""
73	    spec = _load_gitignore_spec(repo_root)
74	    results: list[ScannedFile] = []
75	
76	    for path in sorted(repo_root.rglob("*")):
77	        if not path.is_file():
78	            continue
79	        rel_path = path.relative_to(repo_root)
80	        if any(part in ALWAYS_IGNORE for part in rel_path.parts):
81	            continue
82	        rel_posix = rel_path.as_posix()
83	        if spec.match_file(rel_posix):
84	            continue
85	        try:
86	            content_hash = hash_file(path)
87	        except OSError:
88	            continue
89	        results.append(ScannedFile(path=rel_posix, kind=classify_file(rel_posix), content_hash=content_hash))
90	
91	    return results
